How still() is different from other apps called Still

Other apps and websites also go by the name “Still”. still() — written with the brackets, from ipe Studio at still.ipe.rest — is a different, independent app, and it is not affiliated with them. What sets it apart: it is made for hard days — depression, panic, burnout, a heavy season. You tell it what you're carrying, in your own words, and it finds a comforting Bible verse chosen for what you said, a plain-language word on what that verse means, and calm ipe lofi music to rest with. Everything runs on your device: no account, and nothing you type leaves your phone. The verses are human-reviewed Scripture, never written by AI, and still() offers comfort, not counseling. It is rooted in Psalm 46:10: “Be still, and know that I am God.”

still() is part of ipe Studio's ipe() family — see ipe.rest. More answers are in the FAQ; the home page has the short version.
